name: NOAA/NOS historical California seabed-description points

producer.name: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information, National Ocean Service hydrographic seabed descriptions

units.observation_time_if_present: Unix milliseconds in ArcGIS response; source meaning needs per-survey review
units.coded_nature_if_present: IHO S-57 nature-of-surface codes, sometimes absent or malformed

spatial.horizontal_crs: Original ArcGIS service point geometry requested in WGS84; coordinate uncertainty varies by source and is not resolved

temporal.update_cadence: Monthly complete-page audit; review any changed source before replacing public aggregates

provenance.access_service: Original NOAA NCEI ArcGIS MapServer point layer, all 3,591 California-envelope records via two OBJECTID-ordered pages
transformations: Checked official service name, point geometry, required fields, 2,000-record pagination capability, complete bounded count and distinct OBJECTIDs.
Pinned the two direct original response SHA-256 values a2ce6470668e6b21294de336025cbdbf8a0650e1bd15c574decb0b54b74211ed and ffc921a0bdfb8f2b5a540277fb4db3102c9c8ff2b5bb2ee320a8426dfc55154c.
Assigned actual WGS84 points to 19 approximate browse sectors; published only source-code and sparse substrate-description counts, with one implausible future date excluded.

evidence.supports: NOAA describes the compiled NOS/USCGS seabed-description collection, its mixed sources, free-text sediment descriptions and later S-57 nature-of-surface coding.
Direct point layer returned 3,591 California-envelope records in two complete pages; 14 of 19 browse sectors contain one or more samples.

limitations: Sparse historical samples are not continuous substrate coverage, a reef boundary, fish observation or navigational sounding. Five browse sectors have zero sampled points in this bounded service audit.
Observed dates with usable values span 1968–2016, and one source value implies 2080; that implausible date is excluded rather than treated as a current sample.
Most original NATSUR codes are missing. Free-text rock/boulder/cobble word counts are uncurated and must not be treated as independently verified rock habitat.
Sample coordinate uncertainty and source provenance vary. The original raw point records remain unpublished while rights and individual-survey accuracy are unresolved.
No date-specific rules, MPA clearance, depth, safe approach, fishing score or chartplotter export follows from these aggregates.
